entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your phantom can deliver spells at a greater range than usual.

Prerequisite(s): Phantom class feature, phantom with the deliver touch spells ability.

Benefit(s): The distance from you at which your phantom can deliver touch spells increases by 20 feet.
